categories_thin: Title and settlement: only River Edge Title (own site + ALTA) and one unverified D&B record for Greater New Jersey Title Agency were found at Metuchen addresses; the NJ DOBI title-company list is a statewide PDF and was not filtered for Metuchen.
Real estate appraisal: Wade Appraisal plus Direct Appraisal Services (mailing address only). Most appraisers covering Metuchen are individuals based in Edison or Woodbridge.
Optometry: only Metuchen Vision has a Metuchen-address independent practice; the other local option is a Pearle Vision-branded doctor group, excluded by rule.

Real estate brokerage: most Metuchen-address offices are franchises (Weichert, Coldwell Banker, BHHS, Keller Williams, RE/MAX) and were excluded by rule; the independent brokerages found were Diamond Realty, Capital Property Realty, Debbie Jacobs Realty and International Realty Group.
Surveying: only one firm (Landmark Surveys) found; surveying firms in the area are mostly based in Edison and Woodbridge.
Staffing was thin in the first pass; the revision round added D'Andrea Associates (single directory record), but most employment agencies in the area are Edison-based.
caveats: Chain policy applied explicitly in this revision: brand and multi-site corporate operations were removed - Trinity Rehab (its own site lists around two dozen NJ clinics), Hackensack Meridian Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation, Kessler Rehabilitation Center, LenoyMED (three NJ locations per its site), and Computer Troubleshooters (franchise brand). Small independent professional practices that happen to have two or three offices (podiatry, dental, physical therapy, audiology, group therapy) were kept and flagged in notes.

Tenants of shared professional buildings (406 Main St, 402 Main St, 267 Amboy Ave, 276 Main St, 61 Pearl St, 16 Pearl St, 495 Main St, 450 Main St, 10 Station Pl) are separate businesses and were not merged, but each entry now carries a shared-suite note so outreach does not double-contact one receptionist.
Google Maps returned only a limited result view from this environment; Bing Maps, chamber and third-party directories were used to compensate, so small offices may still be undercounted.

Yellow Pages, Yelp, Superpages, Manta, D&B, WhereOrg, NPI Profile, ChamberofCommerce.com and Cylex all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; a few listings come only from search-result snippets and are flagged in active_evidence and notes.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable, so no OSM cross-check of office/health POIs was possible.
Several directories file Edison or Woodbridge businesses under a 'Metuchen' label; only entries with an explicit Metuchen address (or a Metuchen-specific practice page) were kept.
Solo practitioners (therapists, physicians, CPAs) are included as independent businesses; several list only a suite or no street address and are marked Unknown.
Scope note: this zone covers Metuchen for category groups A and B only; trades, retail and manufacturing (groups C and D) were not surveyed in this pass.
data_gaps: No municipal business license or registry list is published by Metuchen borough, so there is no authoritative denominator for completeness.
The Metuchen Area Chamber of Commerce member directory exists only as a print/PDF community guide (Townsquare Publications); chamber-only members outside the downtown district may be missing.

Removed in this revision as unverifiable or unusable: Platinum Property Management (a Middlesex Greenway appendix lists 569 Middlesex Ave with phone 732-576-2085, but a current directory shows the same phone for Platinum Property Mgmt at 7 State Route 27, Edison 08820 - address unresolved); Metuchen Modern Design Workshop (2020 downtown-alliance report only); and the directory entries 'Office of Brian Atienza', 'Office of Daren Hughes', 'Office of Julie Mulk' at 406 Main St, which name individuals with no business name, specialty, phone or site.
Self Image Solutions (283 Main St) is kept but is a weak record: the only support is one downtown directory listing and the website it links does not resolve; verify it still trades.
Greater New Jersey Title Agency (4 Bridge St) and D'Andrea Associates (296 Amboy Ave) rest on single bulk-directory records whose pages returned 403; the triage team must confirm.
Many dentist and physician entries from ranking and provider directories lack street addresses; they need triage confirmation.
Acupunk NYC is listed at 315 Main St by the downtown directory and 463 Main St by another directory - address conflict unresolved.
Metuchen Physical Therapy LLC (15 Amboy Ave) shares an address with Kalinowski Chiropractic, which advertises physical therapy; may be one business.
Online-only therapists listed under Metuchen on Psychology Today (no Metuchen office) were skipped.
